REPO = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
LIVE_PROGRESS = {}


def prepare(root):
    import numpy as np
    import yaml

    root = root.resolve()
    assert root.is_relative_to(REPO / ".cache")
    assert not root.exists()
    recipe = REPO / "configs/quality-v143-objective-floor-v150.yaml"
    config = yaml.safe_load(recipe.read_text())
    previous = Path(config["previous_trial"])
    old = read(previous / "plan-v1.json")
    guard(old)
    assert ref(config["shared_training_recipe"]["path"]) == config["shared_training_recipe"]
    shared = yaml.safe_load(Path(config["shared_training_recipe"]["path"]).read_text())
    assert all(
        config[k] == shared[k]
        for k in ("steps", "batch_size", "max_window", "lr", "warmup", "gradient_clip", "EMA_decay")
    )
    cache_path = previous / "cache-result-v1.json"
    cached = read(cache_path)
    assert cached["all1000_input_target_fingerprints_exact_V147"]
    assert cached["parent_before"] == cached["parent_after"]
    assert cached["DINO_before"] == cached["DINO_after"] == config["expected_DINO_sha256"]
    assert len(cached["batches"]) == 1000
    cases = read(previous / "quality-design-v1.json")["observations"]
    controls = read(config["ADC_controls"])
    assert controls["status"] == "completed24-fixed-ADC-parent-contexts"
    assert len(controls["observations"]) == 24
    assert controls["parent_before"] == controls["parent_after"]
    assert controls["DINO_before"] == controls["DINO_after"] == config["expected_DINO_sha256"]
    cases += controls["observations"]
    assert len(cases) == 822 and len({c["id"] for c in cases}) == 822
    expected_review_bytes = sum(
        int(np.prod(np.load(c["parent"]["path"], mmap_mode="r").shape)) * 4 * 4 for c in cases
    )
    assert shutil.disk_usage(REPO).free > 98 * 2**30 + expected_review_bytes
    assert shutil.disk_usage("/mnt/external").free > 208 * 2**30
    assert psutil.virtual_memory().available > 52 * 2**30
    for item in cached["batches"]:
        path = Path(item["arrays"]["path"])
        assert path.is_relative_to(REPO) and path.is_file()
    root.mkdir(parents=True)
    work = root / "work"
    for source in (REPO / "src/demosaic").glob("*.py"):
        dest = work / "src/demosaic" / source.name
        dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        shutil.copyfile(source, dest)
    for name in (
        "train_directional_bank_trial.py",
        "train_v43_quality_trial.py",
        "profile_raw_kernel_inference.py",
        "review_v146_window_transfer.py",
    ):
        dest = work / "scripts" / name
        dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        shutil.copyfile(REPO / "scripts" / name, dest)
    runner = work / "scripts" / Path(__file__).name
    runner.write_text(relocated_controller_source(Path(__file__).read_text(), REPO))
    target = work / "configs" / recipe.name
    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    shutil.copyfile(recipe, target)
    save(
        root / "quality-design-v1.json",
        {
            "observations": cases,
            "endpoints": [
                f"{arm}-{endpoint}-step1000"
                for arm in config["arms"]
                for endpoint in ("raw", "EMA")
            ],
            "new_component_forwards": 3288,
            "new_parent_DINO_forwards": 0,
            "new_noise_draws": 0,
            "scope": "All4 fixed final endpoints on822 cases:retained798 plus24 fixed ADC controls. Exact blank/quiet errors and both standing real scenes,priors,windows,JPEGs. Qualitative real references notGT. Adaptive reused cohort.",
        },
    )
    baseline = read(previous / "review-result-v1.json")["collections"]["phase-matrix-raw-step1000"]
    collection = read(baseline["path"])
    plan = {
        "root": str(root),
        "work": str(work),
        "config": ref(target),
        "runner": ref(runner),
        "parent": config["parent"],
        "previous": str(previous),
        "shared_recipe": config["shared_training_recipe"],
        "cache": ref(cache_path),
        "prefix": cached["batches"][:10],
        "legacy_base": ref(Path(old["work"]) / "src/demosaic/late_spectral_detail.py"),
        "baseline_collection": baseline,
        "baseline_export": collection["export"],
        "inputs": [
            ref(recipe),
            ref(target),
            ref(previous / "plan-v1.json"),
            ref(cache_path),
            ref(previous / "cache-trace-v1.jsonl"),
            ref(previous / "quality-design-v1.json"),
            ref(config["parent"]["path"]),
            config["shared_training_recipe"],
            baseline,
            collection["export"],
            ref(root / "quality-design-v1.json"),
            ref(config["ADC_controls"]),
        ],
        "frozen_files": {str(p): ref(p)["sha256"] for p in work.rglob("*") if p.is_file()},
        "source_modules": len(list((work / "src/demosaic").glob("*.py"))),
        "new_parent_DINO_forwards": 0,
        "new_noise_draws": 0,
        "adopted_training_observations": 4000,
        "expected_quality_output_bytes": expected_review_bytes,
        "scope": config["scope"],
    }
    assert plan["source_modules"] == 85
    for name, digest in old["frozen_files"].items():
        source = Path(name)
        if source.parent.name == "demosaic" and source.name != "late_spectral_detail.py":
            assert ref(work / "src/demosaic" / source.name)["sha256"] == digest
    plan["inputs"] += [plan["legacy_base"]]
    save(
        root / "preflight-v1.json",
        {
            "status": "pass-source-cache-and-headroom",
            "adopted_cache_batches": 1000,
            "adopted_observations": 4000,
            "new_parent_DINO_or_noise": 0,
            "expected_quality_output_bytes": expected_review_bytes,
            "frozen_neural_sources": 85,
            "scope": "Existing V148 training cache is read only, shared by both fresh arms.24 new ADC parent contexts are cached separately before head training; no source-photo/original lookup.",
        },
    )
    plan["inputs"].append(ref(root / "preflight-v1.json"))
    save(root / "plan-v1.json", plan)
    guard(plan)
    return root / "plan-v1.json"


def classes():
    from demosaic.late_spectral_matrix import LateSpectralMatrixDetail

    return {"native-matrix": LateSpectralMatrixDetail, "floor16-matrix": LateSpectralMatrixDetail}


def spectral_loss_with_floor(module, target, colors, aux, floor):
    """Training-only original coefficient objective with an explicit variance floor."""
    import torch

    from demosaic.cfa import mosaic
    from demosaic.precision import ieee_fp32

    with torch.autocast(target.device.type, enabled=False), ieee_fp32():
        clean, _ = module.analysis(mosaic(target.float(), colors), aux["geometry"][4])
        desired = clean - aux["parent_spectrum"]
        band = getattr(module, f"band_{aux['geometry'][4]}")
        variance = aux["noise_power"][:, :, None, None].clamp_min((floor / 65535) ** 2)
        return ((aux["spectral_delta"] - desired).abs().square() / variance * band).sum() / (
            band.sum().clamp_min(1) * clean.shape[0] * 4
        )


def runtime(plan):
    import torch

    os.nice(10)
    os.sched_setaffinity(0, sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2])
    torch.set_num_threads(2)
    torch.set_num_interop_threads(1)
    torch.set_float32_matmul_precision("highest")
    torch.backends.cuda.matmul.allow_tf32 = torch.backends.cudnn.allow_tf32 = False
    torch.backends.cudnn.benchmark = False
    torch.backends.cudnn.deterministic = True
    torch.use_deterministic_algorithms(True)
    torch.cuda.set_per_process_memory_fraction(
        12 * 2**30 / torch.cuda.get_device_properties(0).total_memory
    )
    assert psutil.virtual_memory().available > 52 * 2**30


def resource_check(root):
    assert psutil.virtual_memory().available > 32 * 2**30
    assert shutil.disk_usage(root).free > 96 * 2**30
    assert shutil.disk_usage("/mnt/external").free > 208 * 2**30


def parity(plan):
    import numpy as np
    import torch
    from profile_raw_kernel_inference import model_hash

    root = Path(plan["root"])
    assert ref(plan["legacy_base"]["path"]) == plan["legacy_base"]
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(
        "demosaic._v148_legacy_base", plan["legacy_base"]["path"]
    )
    legacy = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(legacy)
    saved = torch.load(plan["baseline_export"]["path"], map_location="cpu", weights_only=True)
    module = classes()["native-matrix"](256).cuda().eval()
    module.load_state_dict(saved["state_dict"], strict=True)
    collection = read(plan["baseline_collection"]["path"])
    archived = {o["id"]: o["prediction"] for o in collection["observations"]}
    cases = read(root / "quality-design-v1.json")["observations"]
    selected = [c for c in cases if c["kind"] == "mesh" and c["seed"] == 2026112302]
    selected += [
        c
        for c in cases
        if c["kind"] == "photo"
        and (
            "3e638bbb" in c["id"]
            or ("02a76fd3" in c["id"] and c["variant"]["name"] == "photo-faint")
        )
    ]
    selected += [
        c
        for c in cases
        if c["kind"] == "flat"
        and c["id"]
        in (
            "flat512-gray-l0.02-adc-only-RGGB",
            "flat512-gray-l0.02-iso6400-prior-RGGB",
            "gray-l0.02-adc-only-RGGB",
            "gray-l0.02-iso12800-prior-RGGB",
        )
    ]
    selected += [
        c
        for c in cases
        if c["kind"] == "real"
        and (
            c["id"].startswith("mesh-") or c["id"] in ("main-overcast-sky", "main-building-detail")
        )
    ]
    assert len(selected) == 28
    before = model_hash(module)
    rows = []
    for case in selected:
        resource_check(root)
        assert (
            ref(case["arrays"]["path"]) == case["arrays"]
            and ref(case["parent"]["path"]) == case["parent"]
        )
        a = dict(np.load(case["arrays"]["path"]))
        base = torch.from_numpy(np.load(case["parent"]["path"])).cuda()
        inputs = [torch.from_numpy(a[k]).cuda() for k in ("packed", "variance", "colors", "wb")]
        with torch.inference_mode():
            first = module(base, *inputs).cpu().numpy()
            second = legacy.LateSpectralDetail.forward(module, base, *inputs).cpu().numpy()
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(first, second)
        assert ref(archived[case["id"]]["path"]) == archived[case["id"]]
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(first, np.load(archived[case["id"]]["path"]))
        rows.append({"id": case["id"], "exact_legacy_forward_and_archived": True})
    assert model_hash(module) == before
    save(
        root / "parity-result-v1.json",
        {
            "status": "pass28-exact-native-control-replays",
            "plan": ref(root / "plan-v1.json"),
            "legacy_base": plan["legacy_base"],
            "baseline_export": plan["baseline_export"],
            "rows": rows,
            "component_forward_evaluations": 56,
            "new_parent_DINO_forwards": 0,
            "new_noise_draws": 0,
            "owner": {"pid": os.getpid(), "created": psutil.Process().create_time()},
            "scope": "Current local-feature hook and old frozen forward agree exactly on all28 native256/384/512/768 cases covering everyCFA and protected real controls. Both agree with saved V148 matrix raw predictions. No target/reference enters either forward.",
        },
    )


def fit(plan, phase):
    import numpy as np
    import torch
    import yaml

    from demosaic.prediction_archive import fingerprint

    root = Path(plan["root"])
    config = yaml.safe_load(Path(plan["shared_recipe"]["path"]).read_text())
    recipe = yaml.safe_load(Path(plan["config"]["path"]).read_text())
    counts = {label: 0 for label in recipe["arms"]}
    updates = dict(counts)
    LIVE_PROGRESS.update(phase=phase, counts=counts, updates=updates, last_completed_step=0)

    def fresh():
        modules = {k: classes()[k](256).cuda() for k in recipe["arms"]}
        for name, value in modules["native-matrix"].state_dict().items():
            assert torch.equal(value, modules["floor16-matrix"].state_dict()[name])
        for label, m in modules.items():
            assert (
                sum(p.numel() for p in m.parameters()) == recipe["arms"][label]["parameters"]
                and len(m.state_dict()) == 12
            )
            m.register_forward_hook(
                lambda *args, label=label: counts.__setitem__(label, counts[label] + 1)
            )
        opts = {k: torch.optim.AdamW(m.parameters(), lr=config["lr"]) for k, m in modules.items()}
        emas = {
            k: {n: v.detach().clone() for n, v in m.state_dict().items()}
            for k, m in modules.items()
        }
        return modules, opts, emas

    modules, optimizers, emas = fresh()
    maximum = {k: {n: 0.0 for n, _ in m.named_parameters()} for k, m in modules.items()}
    cache_rows = read(plan["cache"]["path"])["batches"] if phase == "train" else plan["prefix"]
    checkpointdir = root / "checkpoints"
    checkpointdir.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    trace = []
    last = 0
    journal = (root / f"{phase}-trace-v1.jsonl").open("x")

    def checkpoint(step):
        dest = checkpointdir / f"{phase}-step{step:04d}.pt"
        assert not dest.exists()
        with dest.open("xb") as stream:
            torch.save(
                {
                    "step": step,
                    "horizon": 1000,
                    "module_config": {"max_window": 256},
                    "arms": recipe["arms"],
                    "models": {k: m.state_dict() for k, m in modules.items()},
                    "emas": emas,
                    "optimizers": {k: o.state_dict() for k, o in optimizers.items()},
                    "counts": dict(counts),
                    "updates": dict(updates),
                    "parent": plan["parent"],
                    "plan": ref(root / "plan-v1.json"),
                    "config": config,
                    "torch_CPU_RNG": torch.get_rng_state(),
                    "torch_CUDA_RNG": torch.cuda.get_rng_state(),
                },
                stream,
            )
        return dest

    for step in range(1, 11 if phase == "smoke" else 1001):
        resource_check(root)
        item = cache_rows[step - 1]
        assert ref(item["arrays"]["path"]) == item["arrays"]
        a = dict(np.load(item["arrays"]["path"]))
        base = a.pop("parent")
        assert {k: fingerprint(v) for k, v in a.items()} == item["inputs"]
        batch = {k: torch.from_numpy(v).cuda() for k, v in a.items()}
        base = torch.from_numpy(base).cuda()
        row = {
            "step": step,
            "batch": item["arrays"],
            "domain": item["metadata"]["domain"],
            "arms": {},
        }
        progress = max(0, step - config["warmup"]) / max(1, 1000 - config["warmup"])
        lr = (
            config["lr"]
            * min(1, step / config["warmup"])
            * (0.1 + 0.9 * (1 + math.cos(math.pi * progress)) / 2)
        )
        for label, module in modules.items():
            optimizer = optimizers[label]
            optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
            for group in optimizer.param_groups:
                group["lr"] = lr
            output, aux = module(
                base, *(batch[k] for k in ("packed", "variance", "colors", "wb")), return_aux=True
            )
            if step == 1:
                assert torch.equal(output, base) and aux["correction"].count_nonzero() == 0
            scale = (
                batch["variance"]
                .clamp_min(0)
                .mean((1, 2, 3), keepdim=True)
                .sqrt()
                .clamp_min(recipe["arms"][label]["loss_floor_DN16"] / 65535)
            )
            error = (output - batch["target"]) / scale
            pixel = (error.square() + config["pixel_epsilon_in_noise_units"] ** 2).sqrt().mean()
            derivatives = [error[..., 1:] - error[..., :-1], error[..., 1:, :] - error[..., :-1, :]]
            gradient = (
                sum(
                    (v.square() + config["gradient_epsilon_in_noise_units"] ** 2).sqrt().mean()
                    for v in derivatives
                )
                / 2
            )
            spectral = (
                module.spectral_supervision(batch["target"], batch["colors"], aux)
                if label == "native-matrix"
                else spectral_loss_with_floor(
                    module,
                    batch["target"],
                    batch["colors"],
                    aux,
                    recipe["arms"][label]["loss_floor_DN16"],
                )
            )
            loss = config["domain_loss_weights"][row["domain"]] * (
                pixel + config["gradient_weight"] * gradient + config["spectral_weight"] * spectral
            )
            assert torch.isfinite(loss)
            loss.backward()
            for name, p in module.named_parameters():
                assert p.grad is not None and torch.isfinite(p.grad).all()
                maximum[label][name] = max(maximum[label][name], float(p.grad.abs().max()))
            norm = torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(module.parameters(), 1.0, error_if_nonfinite=True)
            optimizer.step()
            updates[label] += 1
            decay = min(config["EMA_decay"], (1 + step) / (10 + step))
            with torch.no_grad():
                for name, value in module.state_dict().items():
                    emas[label][name].lerp_(value, 1 - decay)
            row["arms"][label] = {
                "loss": float(loss.detach()),
                "pixel": float(pixel.detach()),
                "gradient": float(gradient.detach()),
                "spectral": float(spectral.detach()),
                "gradient_norm": float(norm),
                "lr": lr,
            }
            del output, aux, error, pixel, derivatives, gradient, spectral, loss, scale
        trace.append(row)
        journal.write(json.dumps(row, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
        journal.flush()
        LIVE_PROGRESS["last_completed_step"] = step
        last = step
        if step == 1 or step % 10 == 0:
            print(
                json.dumps(
                    {
                        "phase": phase,
                        "step": step,
                        "arms": row["arms"],
                        "CUDA_allocated_bytes": torch.cuda.memory_allocated(),
                    }
                ),
                flush=True,
            )
            save(
                root / f"{phase}-progress-v1.json",
                {"step": step, "counts": counts, "updates": updates},
            )
        del batch, base, a
        if phase == "smoke" and step == 8:
            path = checkpoint(8)
            s = torch.load(path, map_location="cpu", weights_only=True)
            modules, optimizers, emas = fresh()
            for label in modules:
                modules[label].load_state_dict(s["models"][label], strict=True)
                optimizers[label].load_state_dict(s["optimizers"][label])
                emas[label] = {n: v.cuda() for n, v in s["emas"][label].items()}
                assert len(optimizers[label].state) == 12 and all(
                    float(v["step"]) == 8 for v in optimizers[label].state.values()
                )
                assert all(
                    torch.equal(v.cpu(), s["models"][label][n])
                    for n, v in modules[label].state_dict().items()
                )
            torch.set_rng_state(s["torch_CPU_RNG"])
            torch.cuda.set_rng_state(s["torch_CUDA_RNG"])
            del s
        if phase == "train" and step % 250 == 0:
            checkpoint(step)
    journal.close()
    final = checkpoint(last) if phase == "smoke" else checkpointdir / "train-step1000.pt"
    assert counts == updates == {k: last for k in modules}
    for label, module in modules.items():
        assert min(maximum[label].values()) > 0 and len(optimizers[label].state) == 12
        assert all(float(v["step"]) == last for v in optimizers[label].state.values())
        assert all(
            torch.isfinite(t).all()
            for state in optimizers[label].state.values()
            for t in state.values()
        )
        assert all(
            torch.isfinite(v).all() for v in [*module.state_dict().values(), *emas[label].values()]
        )
    guard(plan)
    save(
        root / f"{phase}-result-v1.json",
        {
            "status": "completed-matched-head-phase",
            "phase": phase,
            "steps": last,
            "plan": ref(root / "plan-v1.json"),
            "checkpoint": ref(final),
            "counts": counts,
            "updates": updates,
            "parameter_maximum_gradients": maximum,
            "loss_floors_DN16": {k: v["loss_floor_DN16"] for k, v in recipe["arms"].items()},
            "initial_outputs_exact_parent": True,
            "trace": trace,
            "new_parent_DINO_forwards": 0,
            "new_noise_draws": 0,
            "CUDA_peak_allocated_bytes": torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated(),
            "owner": {"pid": os.getpid(), "created": psutil.Process().create_time()},
            "scope": "Both fresh identical native heads consume identical adopted V148 training arrays/parents. Smoke weights discarded. Only the RGB standard-deviation and spectral variance loss floors differ,2/16DN. No training data,physical input,architecture,schedule,optimizer/EMA or horizon change. The separately cached24 ADC review parents are never training inputs. No cache construction,parent/DINO or noise call in head phases.",
        },
    )


def worker(path, phase):
    plan = read(path)
    guard(plan)
    root = Path(plan["root"])
    assert ref(__file__) == plan["runner"]
    (root / f"{phase}.claim").open("x").close()
    runtime(plan)
    try:
        if phase == "parity":
            parity(plan)
        else:
            fit(plan, phase)
    except BaseException as error:
        save(
            root / f"{phase}-failure-v1.json",
            {
                "status": "failed-preserved-no-automatic-retry",
                "error": repr(error),
                "progress": LIVE_PROGRESS,
                "owner": {"pid": os.getpid(), "created": psutil.Process().create_time()},
            },
        )
        raise


def controller(path):
    plan = read(path)
    root = Path(plan["root"])
    (root / "controller.claim").open("x").close()
    state = {
        "plan": ref(path),
        "owner": {"pid": os.getpid(), "created": psutil.Process().create_time()},
        "completed": {},
    }
    child = owner = None
    try:
        for phase in ("parity", "smoke", "train"):
            guard(plan)
            while psutil.virtual_memory().available < 52 * 2**30:
                save(
                    root / "status-v1.json",
                    {**state, "status": "waiting-for-headroom", "phase": phase},
                )
                time.sleep(2)
            env = dict(
                os.environ,
                PYTHONPATH=f"{plan['work']}/src:{plan['work']}/scripts",
                OMP_NUM_THREADS="2",
                OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS="1",
                MKL_NUM_THREADS="1",
                HF_HUB_OFFLINE="1",
                TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE="1",
                CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="0",
                CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=":4096:8",
            )
            with (root / f"{phase}-v1.log").open("x") as log:
                child = subprocess.Popen(
                    [
                        str(REPO / ".venv/bin/python"),
                        "-P",
                        plan["runner"]["path"],
                        "worker",
                        str(path),
                        "--phase",
                        phase,
                    ],
                    cwd=plan["work"],
                    env=env,
                    stdout=log,
                    stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
                    stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                    start_new_session=True,
                )
                owner = {"pid": child.pid, "created": psutil.Process(child.pid).create_time()}
                save(
                    root / "status-v1.json",
                    {**state, "status": "running-declared-phase", "phase": phase, "child": owner},
                )
                observed = 0.0
                last = time.monotonic()
                while child.poll() is None:
                    time.sleep(2)
                    now = time.monotonic()
                    if live(owner) and psutil.Process(child.pid).status() != psutil.STATUS_STOPPED:
                        observed += min(now - last, 5.0)
                    last = now
                    assert observed < (1800 if phase in ("parity", "smoke") else 7200), phase
                assert child.returncode == 0, phase
            assert not live(owner)
            state["completed"][phase] = ref(root / f"{phase}-result-v1.json")
        save(
            root / "status-v1.json",
            {**state, "status": "completed-matched-training-awaiting-fixed-quality-review"},
        )
    except BaseException as error:

def load_module(path, name):
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name, path)

    spec.loader.exec_module(value)
    return value


def main(root):
    os.nice(10)

            assert (
                value.dtype == np.float32
                and value.shape == parent.shape
                and np.isfinite(value).all()
            )
            v = value.astype(np.float64)
            change = v - parent.astype(np.float64)
            row = {
                "id": case["id"],
                "index": index,
                "kind": case["kind"],
                "cohort": case.get("cohort"),
                "method": label,
                "prediction": binding,
                "fresh": case.get("fresh", False),
                "new_forward": label in maps,
                "changed": not np.array_equal(value, parent),
                "correction_RMS_DN16": float(np.sqrt(np.mean(change**2)) * 65535),
            }
            if case["kind"] == "mesh":
                row.update(
                    present=case["present"],
                    seed=case["seed"],
                    **error_metric.errors(value, a["target"], case["ROI_xywh"]),
                    template_gain=float(np.sum(detrend(v[0] - empty) * signal) / np.sum(signal**2)),
                    blank_pixels=int(blank.sum()),
                    blank_added_RMS_DN16=float(np.sqrt(np.mean(change[0][:, blank] ** 2)) * 65535)
                    if blank.any()
                    else None,
                )
                if blank.any():
                    error = (v[0] - a["target"][0].astype(np.float64))[:, blank]
                    means = error.mean(1, keepdims=True)
                    row.update(
                        blank_error_RMS_DN16=float(np.sqrt(np.mean(error**2)) * 65535),
                        blank_spatial_RMS_DN16=float(
                            np.sqrt(np.mean((error - means) ** 2)) * 65535
                        ),
                        blank_DC_RMS_DN16=float(np.sqrt(np.mean(means**2)) * 65535),
                    )
            elif case["kind"] == "photo":
                row.update(
                    variant=case["variant"]["name"],
                    **photo_metric.photo_metrics(value, a["target"], a, case["ROI_xywh"]),
                )
            elif case["kind"] == "flat":
                error = v - a["target"].astype(np.float64)
                dc = error.mean((-2, -1), keepdims=True)
                h, w = error.shape[-2:]
                blocks = error.reshape(1, 3, h // 32, 32, w // 32, 32).mean((3, 5))
                x, y, cw, ch = case["ROI_xywh"]
                crop = error[..., y : y + ch, x : x + cw]
                crop_dc = crop.mean((-2, -1), keepdims=True)
                cb = crop.reshape(1, 3, 5, 32, 5, 32).mean((3, 5))
                row.update(
                    noise=case["noise"]["name"],
                    **error_metric.errors(value, a["target"], case["ROI_xywh"]),
                    full_spatial_RMS_DN16=float(np.sqrt(np.mean((error - dc) ** 2)) * 65535),
                    block32_RMS_DN16=float(np.sqrt(np.mean((blocks - dc) ** 2)) * 65535),
                    crop_block32_RMS_DN16=float(np.sqrt(np.mean((cb - crop_dc) ** 2)) * 65535),
                    maximum_abs_DC_DN16=float(np.max(np.abs(dc)) * 65535),
                )
            elif case["kind"] == "mixed-quiet":
                row.update(
                    noise=case["noise"]["name"],
                    **error_metric.errors(value, a["target"], case["ROI_xywh"]),
                )
                x, y, w, h = case["ROI_xywh"]
                row.update(
                    quiet_error_RMS_DN16=float(
                        np.sqrt(
                            np.mean(
                                (v - a["target"].astype(np.float64))[..., y : y + h, x : x + w] ** 2
                            )
                        )
                        * 65535
                    ),
                    quiet_spatial_RMS_DN16=row["crop_spatial_RMS_DN16"],
                    quiet_added_RMS_DN16=float(
                        np.sqrt(np.mean(change[..., y : y + h, x : x + w] ** 2)) * 65535
                    ),
                )
            else:
                assert case["kind"] == "real"
                row["reference_scored"] = False
                if value.shape[-1] == 512:
                    plane = detrend(value[0]).T.reshape(3, 512, 512)
                    blocks = plane.reshape(3, 16, 32, 16, 32).mean((2, 4))
                    row["detrended_block32_variation_DN16"] = float(
                        np.sqrt(np.mean(blocks**2)) * 65535
                    )
            rows.append(row)
    assert len(rows) == 4686 and sum(r["new_forward"] for r in rows) == 3288
    groups = defaultdict(list)
    for row in rows:
        groups[
            row["kind"],
            row.get("present", row.get("variant", row.get("noise"))),
            row.get("cohort"),
            row["method"],
        ].append(row)
    fields = (
        "full_error_RMS_DN16",
        "crop_spatial_RMS_DN16",
        "crop_relative_band_error",
        "crop_linear_sRGB_luma_band_gain",
        "template_gain",
        "blank_added_RMS_DN16",
        "blank_error_RMS_DN16",
        "blank_spatial_RMS_DN16",
        "blank_DC_RMS_DN16",
        "full_spatial_RMS_DN16",
        "block32_RMS_DN16",
        "crop_block32_RMS_DN16",
        "correction_RMS_DN16",
        "quiet_error_RMS_DN16",
        "quiet_spatial_RMS_DN16",
        "quiet_added_RMS_DN16",
    )
    summary = []
    for (kind, condition, cohort, method), group in groups.items():
        item = {
            "kind": kind,
            "condition": condition,
            "cohort": cohort,
            "method": method,
            "cases": len(group),
        }
        for field in fields:
            values = [r[field] for r in group if r.get(field) is not None]
            if values:
                item[field] = float(np.mean(values))
        if kind == "mesh":
            item["worst_blank_added_RMS_DN16"] = max(r["blank_added_RMS_DN16"] or 0 for r in group)
        if kind == "mesh":
            item["worst_blank_error_RMS_DN16"] = max(
                r.get("blank_error_RMS_DN16", 0) for r in group
            )
        if kind == "flat":
            item["worst_abs_DC_DN16"] = max(r["maximum_abs_DC_DN16"] for r in group)
        summary.append(item)
    save(
        root / "scores-v1.json",
        {
            "status": "completed-array-only-scores",
            "design": ref(design_path),
            "review": ref(root / "review-result-v1.json"),
            "scorer": ref(__file__),
            "metric_sources": [ref(p) for p in metric_paths],
            "rows": rows,
            "summary": summary,
            "new_module_forwards_in_scorer": 0,
            "new_noise_draws": 0,
            "real_reference_scores": 0,
        },
    )
    print("Scored4686 paired rows; real references unscored")

def controller(root, revision=1):
    path = root / f"postprocess-plan-v{revision}.json"
    plan = read(path)
    guard(plan)
    assert ref(__file__) == plan["runner"]
    (root / f"postprocess-v{revision}.claim").open("x").close()
    state = {
        "plan": ref(path),
        "owner": {"pid": os.getpid(), "created": psutil.Process().create_time()},
        "completed": {},
    }
    child = owner = None
    try:
        observed, last = 0.0, time.monotonic()
        while True:
            status = read(root / "status-v1.json")
            if status["status"] == "completed-matched-training-awaiting-fixed-quality-review":
                break
            assert status["status"] != "failed-preserved-no-automatic-retry", status
            assert live(status["owner"])
            save(
                root / "postprocess-status-v1.json",
                {**state, "status": "waiting-for-fixed-matched-training"},
            )
            time.sleep(2)
            now = time.monotonic()
            paused = (
                status.get("child")
                and live(status["child"])
                and psutil.Process(status["child"]["pid"]).status() == psutil.STATUS_STOPPED
            )
            if not paused:
                observed += min(now - last, 5.0)
            last = now
            assert observed < 14400
        training = read(plan["training_plan"]["path"])
        for stage in plan["stages"]:
            guard(plan)
            guard(training)
            while psutil.virtual_memory().available < 52 * 2**30:
                save(
                    root / "postprocess-status-v1.json",
                    {**state, "status": "waiting-for-headroom", "stage": stage["name"]},
                )
                time.sleep(2)
            env = dict(
                os.environ,
                PYTHONPATH=f"{training['work']}/src:{plan['work']}:{training['work']}/scripts",
                OMP_NUM_THREADS="2",
                OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS="1",
                MKL_NUM_THREADS="1",
                HF_HUB_OFFLINE="1",
                TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE="1",
                CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="0",
                CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=":4096:8",
            )
            with (root / f"postprocess-{stage['name']}-v{revision}.log").open("x") as log:
                child = subprocess.Popen(
                    [plan["python"], "-P", *stage["argv"]],
                    cwd=root,
                    env=env,
                    stdout=log,
                    stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
                    stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                    start_new_session=True,
                )
                owner = {"pid": child.pid, "created": psutil.Process(child.pid).create_time()}
                save(
                    root / "postprocess-status-v1.json",
                    {
                        **state,
                        "status": "running-fixed-stage",
                        "stage": stage["name"],
                        "child": owner,
                    },
                )
                observed, last = 0.0, time.monotonic()
                while child.poll() is None:
                    time.sleep(2)
                    now = time.monotonic()
                    if live(owner) and psutil.Process(child.pid).status() != psutil.STATUS_STOPPED:
                        observed += min(now - last, 5.0)
                    last = now
                    assert observed < 1800, stage["name"]
                assert child.returncode == 0, stage["name"]
            assert not live(owner)
            state["completed"][stage["name"]] = {
                "result": ref(stage["result"]),
                "owner": owner,
                "owner_exited": True,
            }
        save(
            root / "postprocess-status-v1.json",
            {**state, "status": "completed-audited-paired-arrays-awaiting-human-native-viewing"},
        )
    except BaseException as error:
        if child is not None and child.poll() is None and live(owner):
            os.killpg(child.pid, signal.SIGTERM)
            child.wait(timeout=30)
        save(
            root / "postprocess-status-v1.json",
            {**state, "status": "failed-preserved-no-automatic-retry", "error": repr(error)},
        )
        raise

def test_loss_floor_preserves_legacy_and_has_expected_ADC_gradient_scale(pattern, noise):
    module = LateSpectralMatrixDetail(8)
    random = torch.Generator().manual_seed(150)
    target = torch.rand(1, 3, 16, 16, generator=random) * 0.02
    colors = color_indices(pattern)[None]

    spectrum, geometry = module.analysis(mosaic(parent, colors))
    delta = (torch.rand(spectrum.shape, generator=random) * 0.001).to(torch.complex64)

    aux = {
        "spectral_delta": delta,
        "geometry": geometry,
        "parent_spectrum": spectrum,
        "noise_power": torch.full(spectrum.shape[:2], noise),
    }
    legacy = module.spectral_supervision(target, colors, aux)
    current = spectral_loss_with_floor(module, target, colors, aux, 2)
    candidate = spectral_loss_with_floor(module, target, colors, aux, 16)
    old_grad = torch.autograd.grad(legacy, delta, retain_graph=True)[0]
    current_grad = torch.autograd.grad(current, delta, retain_graph=True)[0]
    new_grad = torch.autograd.grad(candidate, delta)[0]
    assert torch.equal(legacy, current) and torch.equal(old_grad, current_grad)
    if noise:

    else:

def spectral_loss_with_floor(module, target, colors, aux, floor):
    """Training-only original coefficient objective with an explicit variance floor."""
    import torch

    from demosaic.cfa import mosaic
    from demosaic.precision import ieee_fp32

    with torch.autocast(target.device.type, enabled=False), ieee_fp32():
        clean, _ = module.analysis(mosaic(target.float(), colors), aux["geometry"][4])
        desired = clean - aux["parent_spectrum"]
        band = getattr(module, f"band_{aux['geometry'][4]}")
        variance = aux["noise_power"][:, :, None, None].clamp_min((floor / 65535) ** 2)
        return ((aux["spectral_delta"] - desired).abs().square() / variance * band).sum() / (
            band.sum().clamp_min(1) * clean.shape[0] * 4
        )

        opts = {k: torch.optim.AdamW(m.parameters(), lr=config["lr"]) for k, m in modules.items()}
        emas = {
            k: {n: v.detach().clone() for n, v in m.state_dict().items()}
            for k, m in modules.items()
        }
        return modules, opts, emas

    modules, optimizers, emas = fresh()
    maximum = {k: {n: 0.0 for n, _ in m.named_parameters()} for k, m in modules.items()}
    cache_rows = read(plan["cache"]["path"])["batches"] if phase == "train" else plan["prefix"]
    checkpointdir = root / "checkpoints"
    checkpointdir.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    trace = []
    last = 0
    journal = (root / f"{phase}-trace-v1.jsonl").open("x")

    def checkpoint(step):
        dest = checkpointdir / f"{phase}-step{step:04d}.pt"
        assert not dest.exists()
        with dest.open("xb") as stream:
            torch.save(
                {
                    "step": step,
                    "horizon": 1000,
                    "module_config": {"max_window": 256},
                    "arms": recipe["arms"],
                    "models": {k: m.state_dict() for k, m in modules.items()},
                    "emas": emas,
                    "optimizers": {k: o.state_dict() for k, o in optimizers.items()},
                    "counts": dict(counts),
                    "updates": dict(updates),
                    "parent": plan["parent"],
                    "plan": ref(root / "plan-v1.json"),
                    "config": config,
                    "torch_CPU_RNG": torch.get_rng_state(),
                    "torch_CUDA_RNG": torch.cuda.get_rng_state(),
                },
                stream,
            )
        return dest

    for step in range(1, 11 if phase == "smoke" else 1001):
        resource_check(root)
        item = cache_rows[step - 1]
        assert ref(item["arrays"]["path"]) == item["arrays"]
        a = dict(np.load(item["arrays"]["path"]))
        base = a.pop("parent")
        assert {k: fingerprint(v) for k, v in a.items()} == item["inputs"]
        batch = {k: torch.from_numpy(v).cuda() for k, v in a.items()}
        base = torch.from_numpy(base).cuda()
        row = {
            "step": step,
            "batch": item["arrays"],
            "domain": item["metadata"]["domain"],
            "arms": {},
        }
        progress = max(0, step - config["warmup"]) / max(1, 1000 - config["warmup"])
        lr = (
            config["lr"]
            * min(1, step / config["warmup"])
            * (0.1 + 0.9 * (1 + math.cos(math.pi * progress)) / 2)
        )
        for label, module in modules.items():
            optimizer = optimizers[label]
            optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
            for group in optimizer.param_groups:
                group["lr"] = lr
            output, aux = module(
                base, *(batch[k] for k in ("packed", "variance", "colors", "wb")), return_aux=True
            )
            if step == 1:
                assert torch.equal(output, base) and aux["correction"].count_nonzero() == 0
            scale = (
                batch["variance"]
                .clamp_min(0)
                .mean((1, 2, 3), keepdim=True)
                .sqrt()
                .clamp_min(recipe["arms"][label]["loss_floor_DN16"] / 65535)
            )
            error = (output - batch["target"]) / scale
            pixel = (error.square() + config["pixel_epsilon_in_noise_units"] ** 2).sqrt().mean()
            derivatives = [error[..., 1:] - error[..., :-1], error[..., 1:, :] - error[..., :-1, :]]
            gradient = (
                sum(
                    (v.square() + config["gradient_epsilon_in_noise_units"] ** 2).sqrt().mean()
                    for v in derivatives
                )
                / 2
            )
            spectral = (
                module.spectral_supervision(batch["target"], batch["colors"], aux)
                if label == "native-matrix"
                else spectral_loss_with_floor(
                    module,
                    batch["target"],
                    batch["colors"],
                    aux,
                    recipe["arms"][label]["loss_floor_DN16"],
                )
            )
            loss = config["domain_loss_weights"][row["domain"]] * (
                pixel + config["gradient_weight"] * gradient + config["spectral_weight"] * spectral
            )
            assert torch.isfinite(loss)
            loss.backward()
            for name, p in module.named_parameters():
                assert p.grad is not None and torch.isfinite(p.grad).all()
                maximum[label][name] = max(maximum[label][name], float(p.grad.abs().max()))
            norm = torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(module.parameters(), 1.0, error_if_nonfinite=True)
            optimizer.step()
            updates[label] += 1
            decay = min(config["EMA_decay"], (1 + step) / (10 + step))
            with torch.no_grad():
                for name, value in module.state_dict().items():
                    emas[label][name].lerp_(value, 1 - decay)
            row["arms"][label] = {
                "loss": float(loss.detach()),
                "pixel": float(pixel.detach()),
                "gradient": float(gradient.detach()),
                "spectral": float(spectral.detach()),
                "gradient_norm": float(norm),
                "lr": lr,
            }
            del output, aux, error, pixel, derivatives, gradient, spectral, loss, scale
        trace.append(row)
        journal.write(json.dumps(row, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
        journal.flush()
        LIVE_PROGRESS["last_completed_step"] = step
        last = step
        if step == 1 or step % 10 == 0:
            print(
                json.dumps(
                    {
                        "phase": phase,
                        "step": step,
                        "arms": row["arms"],
                        "CUDA_allocated_bytes": torch.cuda.memory_allocated(),
                    }
                ),
                flush=True,
            )
            save(
                root / f"{phase}-progress-v1.json",
                {"step": step, "counts": counts, "updates": updates},
            )
        del batch, base, a
        if phase == "smoke" and step == 8:
            path = checkpoint(8)
            s = torch.load(path, map_location="cpu", weights_only=True)
            modules, optimizers, emas = fresh()
            for label in modules:
                modules[label].load_state_dict(s["models"][label], strict=True)
                optimizers[label].load_state_dict(s["optimizers"][label])
                emas[label] = {n: v.cuda() for n, v in s["emas"][label].items()}
                assert len(optimizers[label].state) == 12 and all(
                    float(v["step"]) == 8 for v in optimizers[label].state.values()
                )
                assert all(
                    torch.equal(v.cpu(), s["models"][label][n])
                    for n, v in modules[label].state_dict().items()
                )
            torch.set_rng_state(s["torch_CPU_RNG"])
            torch.cuda.set_rng_state(s["torch_CUDA_RNG"])
            del s
        if phase == "train" and step % 250 == 0:
            checkpoint(step)
    journal.close()
    final = checkpoint(last) if phase == "smoke" else checkpointdir / "train-step1000.pt"
    assert counts == updates == {k: last for k in modules}
    for label, module in modules.items():
        assert min(maximum[label].values()) > 0 and len(optimizers[label].state) == 12
        assert all(float(v["step"]) == last for v in optimizers[label].state.values())
        assert all(
            torch.isfinite(t).all()
            for state in optimizers[label].state.values()
            for t in state.values()
        )
        assert all(
            torch.isfinite(v).all() for v in [*module.state_dict().values(), *emas[label].values()]
        )
    guard(plan)
    save(
        root / f"{phase}-result-v1.json",
        {
            "status": "completed-matched-head-phase",
            "phase": phase,
            "steps": last,
            "plan": ref(root / "plan-v1.json"),
            "checkpoint": ref(final),
            "counts": counts,
            "updates": updates,
            "parameter_maximum_gradients": maximum,
            "loss_floors_DN16": {k: v["loss_floor_DN16"] for k, v in recipe["arms"].items()},
            "initial_outputs_exact_parent": True,
            "trace": trace,
            "new_parent_DINO_forwards": 0,
            "new_noise_draws": 0,
            "CUDA_peak_allocated_bytes": torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated(),
            "owner": {"pid": os.getpid(), "created": psutil.Process().create_time()},
            "scope": "Both fresh identical native heads consume identical adopted V148 training arrays/parents. Smoke weights discarded. Only the RGB standard-deviation and spectral variance loss floors differ,2/16DN. No training data,physical input,architecture,schedule,optimizer/EMA or horizon change. The separately cached24 ADC review parents are never training inputs. No cache construction,parent/DINO or noise call in head phases.",
        },
    )


def worker(path, phase):
    plan = read(path)
    guard(plan)
    root = Path(plan["root"])
    assert ref(__file__) == plan["runner"]
    (root / f"{phase}.claim").open("x").close()
    runtime(plan)
    try:
        if phase == "parity":
            parity(plan)
        else:
            fit(plan, phase)
    except BaseException as error:
        save(
            root / f"{phase}-failure-v1.json",
            {
                "status": "failed-preserved-no-automatic-retry",
                "error": repr(error),
                "progress": LIVE_PROGRESS,
                "owner": {"pid": os.getpid(), "created": psutil.Process().create_time()},
            },
        )
        raise


def controller(path):
    plan = read(path)
    root = Path(plan["root"])
    (root / "controller.claim").open("x").close()
    state = {
        "plan": ref(path),
        "owner": {"pid": os.getpid(), "created": psutil.Process().create_time()},
        "completed": {},
    }
    child = owner = None
    try:
        for phase in ("parity", "smoke", "train"):
            guard(plan)
            while psutil.virtual_memory().available < 52 * 2**30:
                save(
                    root / "status-v1.json",
                    {**state, "status": "waiting-for-headroom", "phase": phase},
                )
                time.sleep(2)
            env = dict(
                os.environ,
                PYTHONPATH=f"{plan['work']}/src:{plan['work']}/scripts",
                OMP_NUM_THREADS="2",
                OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS="1",
                MKL_NUM_THREADS="1",
                HF_HUB_OFFLINE="1",
                TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE="1",
                CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="0",
                CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=":4096:8",
            )
            with (root / f"{phase}-v1.log").open("x") as log:
                child = subprocess.Popen(
                    [
                        str(REPO / ".venv/bin/python"),
                        "-P",
                        plan["runner"]["path"],
                        "worker",
                        str(path),
                        "--phase",
                        phase,
                    ],
                    cwd=plan["work"],
                    env=env,
                    stdout=log,
                    stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
                    stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                    start_new_session=True,
                )
                owner = {"pid": child.pid, "created": psutil.Process(child.pid).create_time()}
                save(
                    root / "status-v1.json",
                    {**state, "status": "running-declared-phase", "phase": phase, "child": owner},
                )
                observed = 0.0
                last = time.monotonic()
                while child.poll() is None:
                    time.sleep(2)
                    now = time.monotonic()
                    if live(owner) and psutil.Process(child.pid).status() != psutil.STATUS_STOPPED:
                        observed += min(now - last, 5.0)
                    last = now
                    assert observed < (1800 if phase in ("parity", "smoke") else 7200), phase
                assert child.returncode == 0, phase
            assert not live(owner)
            state["completed"][phase] = ref(root / f"{phase}-result-v1.json")
        save(
            root / "status-v1.json",
            {**state, "status": "completed-matched-training-awaiting-fixed-quality-review"},
        )
    except BaseException as error:
        if child is not None and child.poll() is None and live(owner):
            os.killpg(child.pid, signal.SIGTERM)
            child.wait(timeout=30)
        save(
            root / "status-v1.json",
            {**state, "status": "failed-preserved-no-automatic-retry", "error": repr(error)},
        )
        raise

    y, x = np.mgrid[:512, :512].astype(np.float64)
    recipes = [
        (0.004, [1.0, 0.8, 0.6], 0.043, -0.031),
        (0.02, [0.4, 1.0, 0.7], -0.037, 0.029),
        (0.18, [0.7, 0.9, 1.0], 0.019, 0.047),
        (0.75, [0.6, 1.0, 0.4], -0.041, -0.023),
    ]
    patterns = ["RGGB", "BGGR", "GRBG", "GBRG"]
    maximum_ADC_longdouble_difference = 0.0
    for index, (level, tint, sx, sy) in enumerate(recipes):
        target = (
            level
            * np.array(tint)[:, None, None]
            * (1 + sx * ((x + 0.5) / 512 - 0.5) + sy * ((y + 0.5) / 512 - 0.5))
        )[None].astype(np.float32)

                np.rint(

            ) / np.longdouble(".97")
            difference = float(np.max(np.abs(packed.astype(np.longdouble) - independent)))
            assert difference < 1.04 / 65535
            maximum_ADC_longdouble_difference = max(maximum_ADC_longdouble_difference, difference)
            arrays = {

                "variance": np.zeros_like(packed),

                        "tint": tint,
                        "slopes": [sx, sy],
                    },
                    "fresh": True,
                }

    assert len(cases) == 24 and len({c["id"] for c in cases}) == 24
    work = root / "work"

        target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    runner = work / "scripts" / Path(__file__).name

        root / "plan-v1.json",
        {
            "root": str(root),
            "work": str(work),
            "runner": ref(runner),
            "inputs": inputs + [c["arrays"] for c in cases],

Both source IDs excluded from existing train manifests and all adopted training metadata. No source/original lookup, no RAW/dataz access. Inputs and full target/ROI set fixed before V150 training.",

def parents(path):
    import torch
    from profile_raw_kernel_inference import model_hash

    from demosaic.inference import load_checkpoint
    from demosaic.precision import ieee_fp32
    from demosaic.prediction_archive import fingerprint

    plan = read(path)
    guard(plan)
    root = Path(plan["root"])
    assert ref(__file__) == plan["runner"]
    (root / "parents.claim").open("x").close()
    os.nice(10)
    os.sched_setaffinity(0, sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2])
    torch.set_num_threads(2)
    torch.set_num_interop_threads(1)
    torch.backends.cuda.matmul.allow_tf32 = torch.backends.cudnn.allow_tf32 = False
    torch.backends.cudnn.benchmark = False
    torch.backends.cudnn.deterministic = True
    torch.use_deterministic_algorithms(True)
    torch.cuda.set_per_process_memory_fraction(
        12 * 2**30 / torch.cuda.get_device_properties(0).total_memory
    )
    assert psutil.virtual_memory().available > 52 * 2**30
    with torch.random.fork_rng(devices=[0]):
        model, state = load_checkpoint(plan["parent"]["path"], "cuda")
    assert state["loaded_sha256"] == plan["parent"]["sha256"]
    model.eval().requires_grad_(False).to(memory_format=torch.channels_last)
    before, backbone = model_hash(model), model_hash(model.context.backbone)
    assert backbone == plan["expected_DINO_sha256"]
    counts = {"parent": 0, "DINO": 0}
    model.register_forward_hook(lambda *args: counts.__setitem__("parent", counts["parent"] + 1))
    model.context.backbone.register_forward_hook(
        lambda *args: counts.__setitem__("DINO", counts["DINO"] + 1)
    )
    cpu, cuda = torch.get_rng_state().clone(), torch.cuda.get_rng_state().clone()
    rows = []
    for i, case in enumerate(plan["cases"]):
        assert psutil.virtual_memory().available > 32 * 2**30
        assert (
            shutil.disk_usage(root).free > 96 * 2**30
            and shutil.disk_usage("/mnt/external").free > 208 * 2**30
        )
        arrays = dict(np.load(case["arrays"]["path"]))
        assert ref(case["arrays"]["path"]) == case["arrays"]
        keys = ["packed", "variance", "colors", "wb", "matrix"]
        tensors = [torch.from_numpy(arrays[k]).cuda() for k in keys]
        model.set_noise(0.0, 0.0)
        with torch.inference_mode(), ieee_fp32():
            value = model(*tensors).cpu().numpy()
        assert (
            value.dtype == np.float32
            and value.shape == arrays["target"].shape
            and np.isfinite(value).all()
        )
        dest = root / "parents" / f"parent-{i:03d}.npy"
        np.save(dest, value)
        rows.append(
            {
                **case,
                "parent": ref(dest),
                "input_fingerprints": {k: fingerprint(arrays[k]) for k in keys},
            }
        )
        print(case["id"], flush=True)
    assert counts == {"parent": 24, "DINO": 24}
    assert model_hash(model) == before and model_hash(model.context.backbone) == backbone
    assert torch.equal(cpu, torch.get_rng_state()) and torch.equal(cuda, torch.cuda.get_rng_state())
    guard(plan)
    save(
        root / "result-v1.json",
        {
            "status": "completed24-fixed-ADC-parent-contexts",
            "plan": ref(path),
            "observations": rows,
            "counts": counts,
            "parent_before": before,
            "parent_after": model_hash(model),
            "DINO_before": backbone,
            "DINO_after": model_hash(model.context.backbone),
            "RNG_unchanged": True,
            "new_stochastic_noise_draws": 0,
            "CUDA_peak_allocated_bytes": torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated(),
            "owner": {"pid": os.getpid(), "created": psutil.Process().create_time()},
            "scope": plan["scope"],
